### New in 1.5.5
- **Home Screen Only Pet Visibility**: Pets are now strictly accessible and visible on the Home screen only. Pets will not appear or roam on any other screens (Library, To-do, Stats, Settings, or Profile).
- **Jump & Sit into Each Shelf**: Pets can now dynamically jump onto and sit on each physical shelf on the Home screen, with real-time tracking of shelf plank surfaces even while scrolling.
- **Jump Upwards across Shelves**: Pets can jump upwards from the floor to the first shelf, and continue leaping upwards from shelf to shelf to explore every shelf in your collection before jumping back down.
- **Walk Through Shelves**: Once perched on a shelf, pets walk along the shelf surface between books, sit, groom, and take naps with animated footsteps and cozy expressions.
- **Bird Flight & Perching**: Companion birds swoop through the air on the Home screen, perch directly on shelf planks, walk along shelves, and sing musical notes.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it. It installs over older versions and keeps everything.
